steps.caption: Pouch Sealing
steps.description: Dental instruments are placed into sterile pouches and sealed using a heat-sealing machine before autoclaving.

steps.caption: Autoclave Loading
steps.description: Sealed pouches are arranged and loaded into the autoclave chamber in preparation for the sterilisation cycle.

steps.caption: Sterilisation Cycle
steps.description: The autoclave runs a timed high-pressure steam cycle; the control panel displays cycle progress in real time.

steps.caption: Sharps Disposal
steps.description: Used needles are immediately capped and deposited into a dedicated sharps container following each procedure.
